summary: Traveller's Tales' Lego Batman games adapt DC/Batman characters into co-op Lego action-adventure structure, with the first game still available through PC storefronts.

entries.title: Lego Batman: The Videogame

emulation.notes: Native PC route is preferred; console emulation only for platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with co-op/progress state documented

primary.why: The PC release is the easiest current route for clean capture of the first Lego Batman game, while console and handheld versions are useful comparison routes. Handheld/DS versions can differ more substantially and should be labeled if sampled.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release from Steam or GOG. Record storefront/build, controller/co-op state, story/villain campaign progress, minikit/red brick/character unlock state, graphics settings, and whether handheld/console versions were compared.

secondary.why: PC/HD console route is the main archive target.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 3 / Xbox 360 / Wii / PlayStation 2
all_releases.fidelity: Main Lego action-adventure route with PC preferred for capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: current PC access and clean capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Main PC/console and handheld routes can differ; label the chosen version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Lego Batman 2, Lego Batman 3, or newer Lego DC games.
